- Senior Software Engineer — WeeFlare (Feb 2024–Apr 2025, Abu Dhabi, remote): scaled the RivalN platform from 1,500 to 200,000+ active users; engineered a Redis-backed caching and WebSocket layer sustaining 100,000+ concurrent connections; rebuilt the React admin dashboard (~68% faster); led a team of 4.
- Senior Software Engineer — A1G (May 2024–Apr 2025, Saudi Arabia, remote, part-time): re-architected the SEEC government website on Next.js + Directus CMS to a 95+ Lighthouse score with strong accessibility.
- Software Engineer (Full-Stack) — KAD Integrated Information Systems (Feb 2023–May 2024, Saudi Arabia, remote): delivered the ETEC (Education & Training Evaluation Commission) platform on an N-tier architecture with Keycloak IAM, a multi-database backend (MySQL, CouchDB), Redis and MinIO, containerized with Docker; integrated the SWCC system with SAP (Ariba, S/4HANA).
- Full-Stack Developer — Freelance (Aug 2018–present, Alexandria): delivered end-to-end web apps for 38+ clients across Node.js (NestJS), Laravel and Ruby on Rails.
- Earlier: Software Engineer at the Egyptian Armed Forces (Django/PostgreSQL), Incorta (Java EE, React) and BADR (Ruby on Rails internship).
